summary: Sun Life Financial Inc., a Canadian life insurer, filed a Form 6-K announcing its intention to renew a Normal Course Issuer Bid (NCIB) to repurchase up to 10 million common shares (approx. 1.8% of issued and outstanding shares as of March 31, 2026). The buyback is subject to approval from OSFI and the TSX, expected to commence May 29, 2026, and run for up to 12 months. Purchases will occur on TSX, NYSE, or alternative platforms at market prices, with potential private agreements at a discount. Repurchased shares will be cancelled or used for equity incentive plans. This is a capital return to shareholders as part of the company's capital management strategy. Watch for regulatory approvals and market conditions affecting execution.
